name: Staff of Words
body:
Price 91,800 gp; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 17; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This blackened wood staff is etched with arcane words, runes and symbols along its entire length. It allows use of the following spells:

power word fatigue (1 charge)
power word pain (2 charges)
power word frighten (2 charges)
power word kill (3 charges)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 45,900 gp; Feats Craft Staff; Spells power word fatigue, power word frighten, power word kill, power word pain
